tokens.name: bg-app
tokens.usage: Window background and the canvas behind every panel. Text, text-dim and text-mute all pass 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Rail, top bar, status bar, side panels and drawers. The surface one step above bg-app.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Asset cards, inputs, chips at rest, job rows. Use text or text-dim for body text here; text-mute for captions.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover rows, pressed ghost buttons, the track of toggles and bars. Use text or text-dim on it, never text-mute.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders between panels, card outlines and dividers. Decorative only, never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and checkboxes at rest. Pairs with a fill or label so controls never rely on the border alone.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Plaster. Primary text and icons on every surface (10.3:1 or better).

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text: card meta, labels, inactive tabs, table cells (6.2:1 or better on every surface).

tokens.name: text-mute
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps and units on every surface and on a selected row (4.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: The one accent. Primary button fill, the active stage, the selected rail item marker, the selection outline on cards. Never decoration.

tokens.name: clay-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed-in selection outlines.

tokens.name: clay-text
tokens.usage: Clay-coloured text and icons (links, the active tab label, counts, clay chips) on any surface and on clay-soft, even a chip on a selected row (4.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: clay-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on clay and clay-hover fills (5.5:1).

tokens.name: clay-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the selected rail item, the active tab and a selected row. Text stays text on it.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Done and cached only: status chips, check marks, finished stages (4.5:1 or better on sage-soft over a card). Always next to a word or icon.

tokens.name: sage-soft
tokens.usage: Chip and row tint for done and cached states.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Running only: progress fills, the running glow, the live dot. Always next to a word or icon.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Chip and row tint for running states.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed and over-budget only: failed chips, failed checks, a budget bar past its target. Lighter than sage and always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Chip, row and banner tint for failed states.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus ring with a 2px offset; 7:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs and the onboarding sheet over the app.

styles.name: onboarding-title
styles.usage: One per onboarding step, the step's question or promise.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: The screen or project title in the top bar area. One per screen.

styles.name: emphasis
styles.usage: Selected item names, card titles in large cards, onboarding body.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bake light reused the cache from 2 min ago.
styles.usage: The dense tool default: rows, labels, descriptions, buttons.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Secondary lines on cards and rows, field hints.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels in panels and the status bar. Never for sentences.

styles.name: mono-body
styles.usage: File names, paths, script names, hex values.

styles.name: mono-meta
styles.usage: Log lines, timings and stat values in tables. Tabular by nature.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, chip padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside rows and between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, gaps in a board column.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gaps between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a panel, onboarding field groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Screen gutters on onboarding and empty states.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls, tabs, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Asset cards, panels, nodes, banners, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: The app window, onboarding sheet, large media like the viewport and the compare slider.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips, version badges, the budget meter and toggles.

shadow.note: Shadows are rare and tinted toward graphite. Elevation mostly comes from the bg-* steps.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips and toasts that float over content.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: The app window frame and the onboarding sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-running
tokens.usage: The one glow in the system: a card or pipeline node that is running right now.
